{{Top|leg}}
'''Rogue Nine''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] ([[0 ABY/Legends|0.5]]&ndash;[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Stevan Makintay]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5]]&ndash;[[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
*[[Alinn Varth]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25]]&ndash;[[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:DT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref><ref name="NJO:EoV">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
*Corran Horn ([[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:EL">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
